title: Fix Installed Extension Using Old Tree Command
description: The installed VS Code extension at ~/.vscode-server/extensions/usalu.repo-0.0.1/out/extension.js still uses the old "tree" command (renamed to "search"). VS Code loads this stale installed copy instead of the workspace source. Need to rebuild the extension and update the installed copy. Also fix monorepo tree tests to not silently pass when CLI fails (remove `if(children.length===0) return` pattern and assert non-empty results when CLI binary is available).
summary: Rebuilt VS Code extension and updated installed copy. fetchTreeWithArgs was using old 'tree' command (renamed to 'search'). Exported hasRepoAccess, fixed 3 silent-pass monorepo tree tests to assert non-empty results when CLI is available.
